messages:
Alex W: taking over primary for overnight — quick handoff note. Ongoing alerts: embeddings-p99-latency spike in eu-west and a small ramp in 500s from the embeddings service. Triggered ~17:05 UTC and has been noisy since.
Priya S: thx. severity? customer visible?
Alex W: alert severity set to P1 initially due to cache churn. Customer impact: some customers seeing intermittent 500s (~0.5% of embedding requests) and p99 increased from 120ms -> ~1.2s. No major API-wide outage. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings.batch and internal prefetch worker.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTICE — embeddings-p99-latency (alerts: #embeddings-queue-high-p99, #embeddings-500-error-rate). Pager escalated to primary. See incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency
Miguel R: logs show queue length spike on node eg-emb-12 and frequent KV cache misses. Sample tail:
```
2026-03-15T17:08:12Z eg-emb-12 WARN kv-miss key=usr_pref_42
2026-03-15T17:08:13Z eg-emb-12 ERROR encode_worker timeout 1203ms
```
Miguel R: I already bumped pool size on dedicated-embeddings from 8->10 and enabled short-prefetch policy. That reduced short tail but p99 still high.
SRE Runbook: recommended next steps:
- check KV eviction pressure: `curl http://kv-metrics/evictions` (look for >500/min)
- restart encode_worker on affected hosts one at a time
- if persistent, shift traffic to a compatible model-quantized variant with lower CPU cost
Daniel H: I'm on secondary. I can take host restarts and coordinate model switch if needed. Not near infra console atm, can step in in 10m.
Priya S: is there any rollout in progress that could have caused cache invalidations? frontend or rollout bot?
Alex W: Yes — there was a small config push at 16:50 UTC to prefetch TTLs (rolled out to 60% of hosts). I rolled that back on the config service for eu-west at 17:12. Noticed slight stabilization after rollback.
Miguel R: FYI I applied `--prefetch-window=short` in the routing config for the dedicated pool and cleared local KV cache on eg-emb-12:
```
kubectl exec -it eg-emb-12 -- /bin/sh -c 'service kv-cache flush && systemctl restart encode-worker'
```
Alex W: mitigation list (in-progress):
- scaled dedicated pool +2 (done)
- rolled back prefetch TTL config in eu-west (done)
- cleared KV cache on eg-emb-12, restarting workers (in progress)
- if p99 > 800ms after restarts, plan to shift 20% traffic to model-quantized v1.3 (canary) — Daniel to execute
- monitoring: set short-term dashboard to 30s refresh and added alert mute for noisy low-volume errors to reduce noise
Priya S: coverage check — who is primary after the swap? I'm off at 02:00 UTC.
Alex W: I'm primary until 02:00 UTC. Daniel is secondary and will take over primary if I need to step out. Miguel will handle host restarts and logs. Priya — if you get paged after 02:00, assume Daniel is primary.
Daniel H: confirmed. I have credentials for model rollout and can execute canary shift. I'll watch p99 and error rate during shift.
oncall-bot: REMINDER — on-call rotation: Alex W (primary) -> Daniel H (secondary). Escalation policy unchanged. Link: https://redwood.internal/oncall
Priya S: any known customer escalations? I can triage if we need comms.
Alex W: Not yet. I reached out to SEs for high-usage customers with elevated error rates — waiting on reply. If we see >1% customer impact, we escalate to comms.
Miguel R: after restarts p99 dropped to ~550ms, error rate ~0.3%. Still above normal but improving. Next 15m will tell.
Alex W: plan for the night:
- continue rolling restarts host-by-host (Miguel)
- if p99 has not improved to <400ms in 30m, trigger canary shift (Daniel)
- Priya to monitor SE replies and prep customer comms templates
- I will update this thread at major checkpoints or handoff time
Priya S: noted. thanks. I'll jump in if customers report.
Daniel H: standing by for model shift. will post commands in thread when ready.
Alex W: handing over full context at 18:20 UTC to Daniel if still ongoing. leaving crumb trail in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency#handoff
Priya S: thanks — good notes. :thumbsup:
Daniel H: acknowledged — will update thread on takeover.
